selection: Require healthy and prefault FA/min <=1 where possible; rank feasible by joint localization within1s, within3s, detection within1s, state macroF1, first-error fraction, false alarms, localization p95. Infeasible: minimize excess FA first. Exact ties: earlier policy index, earlier epoch; pilot ties smaller early weight then longer segment. All frozen before any test signals.
scope: No GAN/ROS. Existing 228 native circle flights; no new simulation needed. Same local CNN/LSTM encoders. One optimizer update after each batch of full records for both objectives. Current-state objective uses ordered chunks with detached memory and gradients accumulated across chunks. Legacy record-primary control retains full-trajectory BPTT and prefix-based localization, reported separately.
test_policy: Read only test metadata/hashes during audit. All 12 main checkpoints, scalers and policies must be frozen before numerical test loading. Test physics summary was previously exposed, classification test remains unused for selection.
